name: Let's Felt! Slugs & Snails
label: Hands-on workshop
address: 522 Second Street SE Suite D, Charlottesville, VA, 22902
description: Ever wanted to try needle felting? This is a fun place to start! Join us for a hands-on workshop where you'll create a vibrant 2D slug or snail using colorful wool while learning the basics of this fun and satisfying fiber art. No experience is needed—we'll provide all the tools, materials, and guidance you need to get started. Come make something colorful, a little quirky, and completely your own, then take home your finished creation!
